name: Reflectance and Shading Decomposition Priors
definition: Reflectance is an inherent attribute of surfaces independent of illumination; shading represents brightness reflected from a point to the viewpoint.
summary: Reflectance and Shading Decomposition Priors decouple material properties from illumination in radiance fields to solve intrinsic image ambiguity, enabling consistent object insertion and relighting beyond standard photometric reconstruction.
